description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle database data tier to Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
tasks.reason: The application currently stores photos as Oracle BLOBs and connects to Oracle Database. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver. Update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect. Convert Oracle-specific repository SQL to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, including converting photo storage from Oracle BLOB to PostgreSQL bytea. Use managed identity authentication for the Azure database.
